title: Smooth Move
description: Tokens animate along the path you actually dragged, with a movement style per action — stepping walks, gliding flight, swimming wobble, burrowing, and a teleport effect for blinks. Right-click during a drag to anchor a waypoint. Paths are synced over the socket so every player sees the same motion, and fog of war stays correct mid-move. Travelled distance is measured and recorded as normal, so the combat movement counter works.
